turns.teacher: Good morning, children! Today we will do subtraction with our bundles and sticks. Let us start with fifty two minus twenty seven. Everyone, try it in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you wrote 35. Very nice that you tried so quickly! Can you tell me how you got 35, step by step?
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: So you said 2 is small, so you borrowed a ten and made it 12, then 12 minus 7 is 5. Lovely, that ones part is perfectly right! Then in tens you did 5 minus 2 is 3. Hmm, let us check that.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Arjun, come to the front. Here are 5 bundles of ten and 2 loose sticks. That is fifty two. We need 7 sticks but only 2 are loose. Open one bundle for me. Now count the bundles left on the table.
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Yes, only 4 bundles are left now, not 5. So Arjun, when you borrowed that ten for the ones, what happened to the tens number? Is it still 5?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Exactly! It became 4. Now take away 2 bundles from these 4 bundles. How many bundles stay with you?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Super, Arjun! You remembered to cross out the 5 and write 4 on top. That is the most important step. So 52 minus 27 is 25.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sana, you have been working so nicely and quietly. Can you tell us softly what answer you got?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child

turns.teacher: Now everyone try a new one: sixty three minus twenty eight. Arjun, you also do it with the bundles.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Arjun, before you do the tens, look at your bundles. You opened one for the ones. So how many tens are you starting with now, 6 or 5?
turns.label: targeted_question
